forms.test-setup:cl_defstruct_accepts_docstrin: (progn (when (getenv "AUDIT_REQUIRE_CL") (require 'cl-lib)) (progn (cl-defstruct ec-probe-struct "A struct doc." one (two 2)) (let ((s (make-ec-probe-struct :one 1))) (list (ec-probe-struct-one s) (ec-probe-struct-two s) (ec-probe-struct-p s)))))
forms.test-setup:cl_destructuring_bind_dotted_: (progn (when (getenv "AUDIT_REQUIRE_CL") (require 'cl-lib)) (list (cl-destructuring-bind (a . b) '(1 2 3) (list a b)) (cl-destructuring-bind (a b . c) '(1 2 3 4) (list a b c))))
forms.test-setup:cl_labels_recursion: (progn (when (getenv "AUDIT_REQUIRE_CL") (require 'cl-lib)) (eval '(list (cl-labels ((f (n) (if (<= n 1) 1 (* n (f (1- n)))))) (f 5)) (cl-labels ((ev (n) (if (= n 0) t (od (1- n)))) (od (n) (if (= n 0) nil (ev (1- n))))) (ev 10)) (let ((f (cl-labels ((g (n) (if (<= n 0) 0 (+ n (g (1- n)))))) (lambda (k) (g k))))) (funcall f 4))) t))
forms.test-setup:cl_loop_hash_iteration: (progn (when (getenv "AUDIT_REQUIRE_CL") (require 'cl-lib)) (let ((h (make-hash-table :test 'equal))) (puthash "a" 1 h) (puthash "b" 2 h) (list (sort (cl-loop for k being the hash-keys of h using (hash-values v) collect (cons k v)) (lambda (a b) (string< (car a) (car b)))) (sort (cl-loop for v being the hash-values of h using (hash-keys k) collect (cons v k)) (lambda (a b) (< (car a) (car b)))))))
